payload.core_mechanism_summary: DFS tree traversal assigns 0/1 parity to nodes. Min f=1 if all leaves parity 0 else 3; max f = n-1 - leaf_count + nonleaf_adjacent_to_leaf_count.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a stack-based graph traversal (DFS-like) to explore the tree and assign parities, then computes answers via leaf and adjacency counts. No greedy or bit manipulation is used, making search_dfs_bfs_graph the best fit.
